data.explanation: This letter confirms you have been admitted to the exchange semester and asks you to send back a signed enrollment confirmation to keep your place. The document states the confirmation must arrive by 29 April 2025 (a fixed date printed in the letter). If it does not arrive in time, your place goes to someone on the waiting list instead. If this deadline has already passed, check with the Office of Global Education directly to see whether your place is still available.
